Typography & layout · architecture unchanged

A layout that uses the length of the wall

The earlier proposals stacked the logo and every line in a block at the centre: the group used about half of the 7,924 mm wall, left almost 2 m of bare stone each side, and kept the English and Chinese lines near 100 mm. Here the Lao line runs the full width of the group, the logo sits beside DANSAVANH, and English and Chinese share one row, so the secondary lines can grow without crowding the cornice.

ຜັງເກົ່າກອງທຸກຢ່າງໄວ້ກາງປ້າຍ ຈຶ່ງຫວ່າງຊ້າຍ–ຂວາ ແລະ ແຖວຮອງນ້ອຍ. ຜັງໃໝ່: ລາວແຖວດຽວເຕັມຄວາມກວ້າງກຸ່ມ, logo ຢູ່ຂ້າງ DANSAVANH, ອັງກິດ ແລະ ຈີນ ຢູ່ແຖວດຽວກັນ.
